title: fix: allow 1000-character agent descriptions
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Raises `COMMUNITY_ENDPOINT_DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH` from 160 to 1000 (single source in `shared/community-endpoints.ts`; DB column is unbounded text, no migration)
- Agent and community-endpoint zod schemas now reject over-long descriptions with `Description must be at most 1000 characters`, so the CLI's raw API error names the limit
- Drops the "one line" wording from the dashboard description helper; the field's `maxLength` follows the constant
- Adds a test: 1000-char description accepted, 1001 rejected with the limit in the message
- Code-agent sync keeps trimming the GitHub repo description (GitHub caps it at 350, so the slice never fires)

Addresses feedback in #14930.
